<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic transformation that, in the forward direction, breaks a ketone and forms a C‑C triple bond (consistent with the cycloaddition hint). The valid functional‑group name for ketones is “ketones”.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C triple bonds"],
  "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
  "bonds_broken": null,
  "bonds_order_changed": null,
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
